title: Implement token-bucket rate limiting middleware
description: Implement request rate-limiting middleware for the fixture's HTTP layer using a token-bucket algorithm, configurable per-route with a requests-per-window limit, returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header once a client exceeds its limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests under the configured limit are passed through unmodified.
Requests exceeding the limit receive a 429 response with a numerically correct Retry-After header.
Limits are tracked independently per client identifier (e.g. API key or IP) and per route.
The token bucket correctly refills over time rather than only resetting at fixed window boundaries.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run rate-limit tests using controllable fake timers to assert both throttling and refill behavior deterministically.
groundTruth: A token-bucket store keyed by (clientId, route) holds current token count and last-refill timestamp; each request computes elapsed time, refills proportionally up to bucket capacity, and allows the request only if at least one token remains, decrementing on success.
